providers.reason: 6.8% surge Sept 3 on AI platform adoption and sector rotation into enterprise software; Q2 AI ACV growth strong.
providers.risk: Technical resistance overhead and recent insider selling.

providers.reason: ServiceNow is seeing accelerating adoption of its agentic AI platform, with AI-related annual contract value (ACV) already surpassing $1 billion. Strategic partnerships with IBM and Accenture for modernizing legacy applications provide visible catalysts. The company's high-margin SaaS model offers relative stability as software sentiment recovers from early-year lows.
providers.risk: Overhead technical resistance near the $160 level may cap near-term gains without a broader sector breakout.

providers.reason: Down sharply YTD then up ~9% in five sessions on 1,000 job cuts; AI ACV crossed $1B toward $1.5B target.
providers.risk: Lingering AI-disruption and execution/pricing fears could quickly reverse the oversold bounce.

providers.reason: ServiceNow has broken through a falling trend channel with strong momentum (up 25% in 3 months). Trading at $134, it sits 30% below the $174 analyst consensus target. Q2 revenue grew 24% Y/Y to $4B with $1B in AI revenue (Now Assist). No near-term earnings risk (next report Oct 28) and strong institutional accumulation provides support.
providers.risk: Premium valuation and stiff competition in AI workflow software could trigger profit-taking after the recent 25% rally. Stock remains 31% below 52-week high, suggesting overhead resistance.
